पालय: √pālaya (pāláyati). be protector; protect;  keep. [pāla, 1042f: acct, 1067: quite different is √palāy, ‘go away.’] + pari, protect around.
पावक: pāvaká, a. pure; clear; bright. [√pū, 1181b and a: cf. śvāpada.]
पावन: pāvana, a. purifying; freeing from sin. [√pū, 1150b.]
पिञ्जूल: piñjūla, n. tuft of stalks; grass.
पिण्ड: píṇḍa, m. 	—1. lump; ball; lump (of earth), 988; 	—2. esp. lump or cake of meal offered to the Manes; 	—3. mouthful,  655; piṇḍī, f. meal-cake.
पितामह: pitāmahá, m. father's father, grandfather;  great father. [pitā (nom. s. of pitṛ) + maha, 1314c and d.]
पितृ: pitṛ́ [373], m. 	—1. father; 	—2. pl. father and his brothers (cf. French parent, ‘relative’),  6117; 	—3. pl. the fathers, spirits of the forefathers, the Manes, 6716, 8313, etc. [origin unknown, see 1182d: cf. πατήρ, Lat. pater, Eng. father.]

पितृयज्ञ: pitṛ-yajñá, m. sacrifice to the Manes. [yajñá.]
पितृव्य: pitṛvya, m. father's brother, patruus. [pitṛ, 1228c: cf. πάτρως, Lat. patruus, AS. fædera, ‘father's brother.’]
पित्र्य: pítrya, a. of one's father; of (our) fathers, 7818; of or belonging to or sacred to the Manes. [pitṛ́, 1212b: cf. πάτριος, Lat. patrius, ‘of one's father.’]
पिन्व्: √pinv (pínvati; pipínva; pinvitá). cause to swell or stream. [√pī or pi: 749, 749b, 716.]
पिपासा: pipāsā́, f. desire to drink, thirst. [fr. desid. (1026) of √1pā, ‘drink’: 11494.]
पिपील: pipīlá, m. ant. [perhaps for *pipīḍa, ‘pressed in or constricted in the middle,’ √pīḍ.]
पिश्: √piś (piṃśáti, -te [758]; pipéśa, pipiśé; piṣṭá). adorn. [cf. ποικίλος, AS. fāh, ‘many-colored’; Lat. pic-tor, ‘painter.’]
पिशाच: piśācá, m. one of a class of demons (perhaps personifications of the ignis fatuus); goblin.
पिष्: √piṣ (pináṣṭi; pipéṣa, pipiṣé; ápiṣat; pekṣyáti; piṣṭá; péṣṭum; piṣṭvā́; -píṣya ). crush; grind, 475; mill. [cf. Lat. pinsere, pīsere, ‘crush’: of doubtful kinship is πτίσσω, ‘pound, husk.’] + sam, crush together or to pieces.
पिष्ट: piṣṭá, ppl. milled; as n. meal. [√piṣ: for the mgs, cf. piṣ, piṣṭa, and molere, mola, with mill, meal.]
पिष्टपशु: piṣṭa-paśu, m. effigy of a sacrificial beast made of meal.
पी: √pī or pyā (pyā́yate [761d 1]; pīpā́ya [7863], pipyús; ápyāsīt; pītá, pīná). swell; overflow. [hence pī́-van, πί-ων, ‘fat.’]
पीठ: pīṭha, n. 	—1. seat; 	—2. pedestal (of an image of a god).
पीठचक्र: pīṭha-cakra, n. seat-wagon; wagon with a seat.
पीड्: √pīḍ (pīḍáyati [10412]; pīḍayā́m āsa; pīḍitá; pī́ḍayitum; pīḍayitvā́; -pī́ḍya). press; oppress, pain. [for *pizd, *pisd, 198b3: cf. √piṣ.] + ā, press out, 10320.
पीन: pīná, a. thick, brawny. [‘swollen,’ ppl. of √pī, 957a.]
पीवस्: pī́vas, n. fat. [√pī: cf. πῖαρ, i. e. πῖ-ϝαρ, ‘fat.’]
पुट: puṭa, m. n. fold; cavity; nose (of a basket).  [for *pḷta: cf. -πλασιος, *πτ, in δι-πλάσιος or δί-παλτος, Eng. two-fold.]
पुण्य: púṇya, a. prosperous; happy; lucky, faustus, auspicious, 1213, 591. 10; right, good; as n. good work; sing. collectively, good works, 2817; merit (from good works). [perhaps fr. √puṣ.]
पुण्यगन्ध: púṇya-gandha, a. of good or pleasant smell.
पुण्यपाप: puṇya-pāpa, n. pl. good and bad deeds. [1253a.]
पुण्यश्लोक: puṇya-śloka, a. of good fame; as m. Punyaśloka, epithet of Nala.
पुत्तिका: puttikā, f. white ant. [‘the doll-like insect’: for putrikā.]
पुत्र: putrá, m. 	—1. son; child, 9820; 	—2. whelp; 	—3. shortened form for Putraka as proper name.
पुत्रक: putraka, m. 	—1. little son (as term of endearment), boy; 	—2. Putraka, otherwise Putra, name of the founder of Pātaliputra-pura,  452; --putrikā, f. [1222d], daughter; doll (of wood or lac). [putra.]
पुनर्: púnar, adv. 	—1. back; home; w. ā-gam, go back, 43, 4118; so ā_i, 8314; w. vac, reply, 1919; 	—2. again, 83, 4020; anew; punaḥ punar, again and again, 217; punar, equiv. to punaḥ punar, 413; 	—3. continuative, again, further, 2911; moreover,  168, 5721; besides or in turn, 1010; kim punas tu, but what besides, how much more, a fortiori, 1715; longer, 843; 	—4. but, 462, 19; on the other hand, 2017. पुनःसर: punaḥ-sará, a. coming back (as a ghost from the other world--exactly like the French revenant), and so ghostly, uncanny. [punar, 178.]
पुमांस्: púmāṃs [394], m. man; a male, 597; opp. of strī, e. g. 1049; pumāṃsaḥ putrās, male children, 9820.
पुर्: 2púr [392], f. stronghold; castle; fortified town. [cf. πόλις, ‘city.’]
पुर: pura, n. stronghold; fortified town; city. [2púr, 399.]
पुरंधि: puraṃdhi, 	—1. a. courageous, highspirited,  exalted; 	—2. as m. perhaps as name of a god, Purandhi; 	—3. as f. exaltation.

पुरस्कार्य: puras-kārya, grdv. to be appointed or commissioned, praeficiendus. [see puras + kṛ: also 963b and 1713.]

पुरा: purā́, adv. formerly, 462, 7914; once upon a time, 389, 4820; prep. w. abl. [1128], before, 9517, 10419. [see prá.]

पुरु: purú, a. much, many. [√1pṛ, ‘fill,’ q. v.: cf. πολύ, AS. fela, ‘much, many.’]
पुरुष: púruṣa, m. 	—1. man; 	—2. (as in Eng., man, i. e.) servant; 	—3. the personal and life-giving principle in man and other beings, soul, spirit; then 	—4. personified as The Supreme Spirit, Soul of the Universe,  578.
पुरुषकार: puruṣa-kāra, m. deed of a man, human effort, as opp. to daiva, ‘fate.’
पुरूची: purūcī́, a. f. many, abundant; long. [formally fem. to a stem *puru-ác, ‘directed or reaching in many ways, abundant’: cf. 407.]

पुष्: √puṣ (púṣyati, -te; pupóṣa; ápuṣat; puṣṭá). --1. thrive; bloom; 	—2. trans. cause to thrive; develop; unfold, display, 784.

पुष्ट: puṣṭá, ppl. having thrived; strong; fat. [√puṣ, 9552.]
पुष्प: púṣpa, n. bloom; flower. [poss. for *puṣka, q. v.: cf. 12012 end.]

पूर्ण: pūrṇá, ppl. filled; full. [√1pṛ, ‘fill,’ 957b: cf. Goth. fulls, Eng. full.]
पूर्णमास: pūrṇá-māsa, m. full moon and the fullmoon sacrifice.
पूर्त: pūrtá, ppl. filled; bestowed, fulfilled; as n. [1176a], fulfilment; reward; merit. [√1pṛ, ‘fill,’ 242.]
पूर्व: pū́rva [5254], a. being before in place or time: 	—1. east (cf. prāñc); 	—2. prior; preceding, 8613; pūrva…uttara, former …latter, 218; ancient, 576; of old time, 693, 8310; first spoken, 602; w. past pass. ppl. पृथ्: √pṛth, collateral form of prath, in derivs.

पृथिवीपाल: pṛthivī-pāla, m. keeper of the earth, king.

पृष्ठ: pṛṣṭhá, n. 	—1. back, of an animal; 	—2. the upper side, surface; 	—3. top, of a hill or palace. [cf. Ger. First, ‘ridge of a house’; AS. first-hrōf, ‘ridge-pole’: observe that νῶτος has mgs 1, 2, and 3, that Lat. tergum has mgs 1 and 2, and that Eng. ridge has mgs 1 and 3.]

पैशाच: paiśāca, f. -ī, a. of the goblins. [piśācá, 1208f.]
प्या: √pyā (pyā́yate [761d 1]; ápyāsīt [882]; pyātá). swell; overflow. [a collateral form of √pī, q. v.] + ā, become full of or rich in.

प्रकृति: prakṛti, f. that which one pre-supposes (voraus-setzt), i. e. the original or natural form or condition; nature. [√1kṛ, ‘do, set,’ + pra.]
प्रकोप: prakopa, m. a boiling with rage; anger. [√kup + pra.]
प्रगे: prage, adv. early in the morning.
प्रचृत्तशिख: pracṛtta-śikha, a. with loosened braids or flowing hair. [śikhā.]
प्रचेतस्: prácetas, a. knowing, wise. [√cit + pra, cf. 1151. 2b.]

प्रणय: praṇaya, m. manifestation of one's affection.  [√nī + pra: for ṇ, see 192a.]
प्रणयन: praṇayana, n. 	—1. a fetching; 	—2. means for fetching, vessel. [do.]
प्रणव: praṇava, m. the sacred syllable om. [√nu + pra, q. v.]
प्रणाम: praṇāma, m. bow, reverent salutation. [√nam + pra.]
